name: Documents
description: Create and inspect structured A4 DOCX document artifacts.
instructions: Use write_docx for a requested DOCX artifact and pass the full final Markdown, target filename, and optional font settings. Markdown headings become Word title/heading styles; use a heading named 目录 for an updateable TOC field and <!-- pagebreak --> when an explicit page boundary is required.
Workspace writes require the normal approval flow; never claim the document exists before the tool succeeds.

After creation, call read_office_document and verify that headings, names, dates, figures, references, and conclusions survived the round trip. A user request for a standard report or thesis is not complete if the final answer admits missing pagination, missing sections, or manual reconstruction.

The writer emits A4 page settings, margins, heading styles, an optional TOC field, section page breaks, and page-number footer. Prefer it over an ad-hoc python-docx generator. If a custom generator is genuinely necessary, explicitly set every section to A4 (210 x 297 mm; OOXML page size about 11906 x 16838 twips) and verify the saved package rather than accepting the library's US Letter default.

For a standard Chinese thesis, the final rendered document must contain a cover, Chinese abstract and keywords, English Abstract and keywords, a populated visible table of contents (not an instruction telling the reader to update it), numbered chapters, embedded references, and page numbers. A standard proposal must embed its reference list instead of only pointing to a companion Markdown file.

Before completion, inspect OOXML page dimensions and render every page. Reject blank interior pages, clipped/garbled text, placeholder TOC pages, missing abstracts, missing references, and any Letter-sized output. Do not claim tracked changes, comments, complex tables, or pixel-perfect institutional templates unless separately verified.
